note: Spec-bots §6 named error injections. Probability per opportunity at each rank anchor (Iron .. Challenger); linear in skill between anchors (bot skill after variance). Order of values: iron, bronze, silver, gold, platinum, emerald, diamond, master, grandmaster, challenger. Logged as injectedError for the post-game.

trade_on_cooldown.note: §6 Bronze: trades as soon as cooldowns are up (trigger 70 %)

fight_in_enemy_wave.note: §6 Iron-Silver: ignores the minion-aggro condition of the trade window

ignore_minion_aggro.note: §6 Iron-Silver: auto-attacks a champion inside the enemy wave

no_flash_tracking.note: §6 up to Emerald 50 %: forgets a seen enemy flash

chase_third_kill.note: §6 Gold: chases for another kill into fog

overcommit_after_kill.note: §6 Iron: dives on with 20 % HP after a kill

flash_wrong_direction.note: §4.2 Iron 15 %: escape flash in the wrong direction

roam_from_push.note: §5.1 Iron-Silver 30 %: roams away from a pushing wave

flash_in_dive.note: §6 Gold 40 %: flashes out of a dive instead of tower dancing (Platinum+ correct)

carry_too_far.note: §7 Gold: carry stands 150 units too far forward (Diamond correct)

late_recall.note: §8 Iron: recalls only below 25 % HP or randomly

idle_after_shove.note: §8 Gold 40 %: shoves and idles in the river
